references.text: God explains that he has taken the Levites from the Israelites in place of all the firstborn, and that all the firstborn belong to him since he struck down the firstborn in Egypt.
The Levites shall belong to the Lord in place of all the firstborn among the Israelites.
The Lord commands that the Levites be taken in place of all the firstborn among the Israelites.
The Levites are to be set apart from the Israelites and belong to the Lord.
All the firstborn in Israel belong to the Lord, and he has taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn.
The Lord commands that all the firstborn be consecrated to him, both of humans and animals.
Everything that opens the womb is to be given to the Lord, and the firstborn of humans must be redeemed.
The firstborn of sons shall be given to the Lord.
Everything that opens the womb belongs to the Lord, and the firstborn of humans must be redeemed.
The firstborn of animals already belong to the Lord and cannot be consecrated as a special offering.
In the law of the Lord it is written that every male firstborn shall be called holy to the Lord.
